titles: "승자의 저주? 그런 거 없다" 밥캣·하만·슈페리어 에식스가 지금도 1위인 진짜 이유
"승자의 저주? 그런 거 없다" 첫해 이익 0.6% 하만·밥캣이 지금도 1위인 진짜 이유

image_concepts.A: 3분할 — 왼쪽 회색 안개 속 멈춘 원전 냉각탑, 가운데 경탄하는 익명 미국인 사업가, 오른쪽 황금 역광 속 소형 로더 + 큰 태극기
image_concepts.B: 한국 세 실물 영웅샷 — 소형 로더·구리 권선 코일·빛나는 차량 디지털 계기판이 로우앵글로 나란히, 뒤로 휘날리는 태극기
image_concepts.C: 실물 클로즈업형(고배율 공식) — 실물 1개를 크게 + 익명 인물 1명

final_thumbnail.image: 6번 프롬프트 + 정식 로고(DOOSAN·LS Cable·SAMSUNG) 수동 합성, 인물 없음

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사. 왼쪽 멈춘 원전, 가운데 놀란 미국인 사업가, 오른쪽 황금빛 속 흰·주황 소형 로더와 큰 태극기 — 3분할 승패 구도.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic high-saturation HDR image split into three vertical sections. On the left, a silent nuclear power plant cooling tower and an idle construction crane shrouded in cold grey fog, desaturated and dusty, with a small ordinary Japanese national flag (white flag with red circle) in the upper left corner. In the center, an attractive American businessman in his 60s with a likeable face, chest-up close-up filling 60% of the frame height, jaw dropped in awe, looking toward the right. On the right, a large white-and-orange compact skid steer loader without any logo, shot from a heroic low angle, lifting a bucket of earth under golden backlight with glowing rim light, lens flare and sparks, and a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving proudly in sunlight in the upper right corner. Triumphant, victorious atmosphere where the Korean side is bigger, brighter and closer than the left.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사 변주. 왼쪽 공사가 멈춘 녹슨 원전 현장, 가운데 경탄하는 익명 한국인 기술자, 오른쪽 빛나는 공사장 위 로더 행렬과 태극기.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic HDR three-part comparison. On the left, an abandoned nuclear reactor construction site with rusted rebar and a stopped crane under a heavy overcast sky, cold desaturated blue-grey tones, a small plain Japanese national flag (white flag with red circle) in the corner. In the center, a confident proud Korean engineer in a work uniform and safety helmet, attractive and likeable, arms crossed with a warm smile, chest-up and large in frame. On the right, a row of white-and-orange compact loaders without logos working on a bright American construction site at golden hour, glowing rim light and lens flare, with a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving in sunlight in the upper right. Epic, triumphant mood with a clear contrast of dark failure on the left and radiant success on the right.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사. 로우앵글로 나란히 선 소형 로더·구리 권선 코일 더미·빛나는 차량 디지털 계기판, 뒤로 큰 태극기와 황금 역광.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic heroic low-angle shot of three symbols of Korean-owned American industry standing side by side in the upper half of the frame: a white-and-orange compact skid steer loader without logos, a towering stack of shining copper magnet wire coils, and a glowing car digital cockpit dashboard with wide curved screens. Behind them, a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waves proudly against a sunset sky, lit by golden backlight, glowing rim light and floating sparks. Bright vibrant high-saturation HDR colors, epic cinematic and victorious atmosphere, every object large and instantly recognizable.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업형 ① — 화면 위쪽을 꽉 채운 흰·주황 소형 로더 실물 + 그 옆에서 웃는 50대 한국인 기술자
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic close-up of a single white-and-orange compact skid steer loader without any logo, filling more than half of the frame across the upper area, shot from a slightly low angle so its bucket, tires and cab look massive and detailed. Beside it, an attractive Korean engineer in his 50s with a likeable face, wearing a work uniform and safety helmet, rests one hand on the machine and smiles with quiet pride, shown chest-up. Behind them, a bright American construction site at golden hour with warm backlight and soft lens flare. Bright vivid high-saturation colors, simple uncluttered background so the machine reads instantly at small size.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업형 ② — 빛나는 차량 디지털 계기판과 도어 스피커 실물 + 운전석에서 감탄하는 50대 여성 운전자
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic close-up inside a premium car, where a glowing wide curved digital cockpit display and a polished metal door speaker grille fill more than half of the frame across the upper area, every detail crisp and luminous. In the driver's seat, an attractive Korean woman in her 50s with a warm likeable face listens with an impressed, delighted expression, shown chest-up. Soft blue dashboard glow mixed with warm golden light through the windshield, no brand logos or readable text anywhere. Bright vivid high-saturation colors, clean composition so the dashboard and speaker are recognizable at thumbnail size.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 최종 썸네일용 — 인물 없이 실물 셋(로더·구리 권선·차량 계기판)을 크게 + 각 실물 아래 로고 붙일 흰 명판
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic high-saturation HDR image with no people. Three real objects stand side by side across the upper 60% of the frame, each large and filling its third of the width: on the left a white-and-orange compact skid steer loader without any logo, in the center a towering stack of gleaming copper magnet wire coils, and on the right a glowing wide curved car digital cockpit dashboard with steering wheel. Directly beneath each object is a clean, empty, softly lit white rounded nameplate panel, blank with no text, sized for a label. Behind them a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waves proudly against a golden sunset sky over a city skyline, with warm golden backlight, rim light and lens flare. The bottom third of the image fades to a dark, simple background. No logos, no letters, no words anywhere.
